title: Pan-Seared Lentejuelas with Flaviantes
description: A simple and delicious dish featuring sautéed lentejuelas and flaviantes, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lentejuelas and sauté for 2-3 minutes until they start to brown.
Add the flaviantes and continue to sauté for another 2-3 minutes until the lentejuelas are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top and serve immediately.
